title: Cosmic Serpent Embrace
description: A surreal painting shows a glossy black humanoid figure with glowing golden eyes intertwined with a white ethereal female figure with horns and pink eyes. A large turquoise and gold serpent coils around both. The background splits between a desert landscape with onion-shaped signs under a swirling blue sky on the left and a mystical purple cosmic scene with a frog wizard, blue monster, and glowing orb on the right.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a sleek black humanoid with glowing golden eyes standing beside a white horned female figure with pink eyes, both wrapped by a large ornate turquoise and gold serpent. Left side features a desert with onion signs and checkered floor under a swirling blue sky, right side shows a mystical purple cosmic realm with a frog wizard casting magic and a blue furry monster, intricate details, vibrant contrasting colors.
